На кутах закріплені чотири мідні карбовані наріжники з півсферичними жуковинами, у центрі — ромбовидна мідна середня жуковина. На передньому обрізі збереглися рештки двох мідних застібок.]

items.office: Front Matter
items.slavonic_text: [Повносторінковий дереворит-фронтиспис у подвійній лінійній рамці: Розп'яття Господа нашого Ісуса Христа. Христос розіп'ятий на хресті на Голгофі; голова у терновім вінці схилена праворуч; кров витікає з пробитого ребра, рук і ніг на підніжжя. Вгорі над хрестом — дощечка титла. Ліворуч хреста — Пресвята Богородиця, знемагаюча від скорботи, підтримувана жінками-мироносицями; праворуч — святий апостол і євангелист Іоан Богослов з рукою на грудях та святий сотник Лонгин у німбі. На тлі — зубчасті мури міста Єрусалима. Дереворит ілюмінований сучасною ручною розфарбовкою мінеральними фарбами (зеленою, кіноварно-червоною, вохрою та коричневою).]
items.english_text: [Full-page woodcut frontispiece within a double-line border: The Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ. Christ is crucified upon the Cross at Golgotha, His head crowned with thorns inclined to the right, with blood streaming from His pierced side, hands, and feet upon the footstool. Above the Cross is a titulus tablet. To the left of the Cross stands the Most Holy Theotokos, swooning in grief and supported by the holy Myrrh-bearing women; to the right stand the holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian with hand placed upon his breast, and the holy Centurion Longinus with halo. In the background rise the battlemented walls and towers of Jerusalem. The woodcut is illuminated with contemporary hand-coloring in green, cinnabar red, ochre, and brown pigments.][^5]

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: [Балканська плетена заставка з рослинними відгалуженнями]
items.english_text: *Services I sing for the Octoechos, the work of our venerable father John of Damascus. On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we bless... [Kathisma] and we sing Stichera: the Resurrection Stichera, three, repeating each one to make six, and the Anatolian Stichera; in the Menaion, Stichera are sung to make ten: Resurrection Stichera to six, and of the Menaion to four. But if there be a great saint, we sing Resurrection Stichera to four, and to the saint to six Stichera. Tone 1:–*

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: гла́сникь. творенїе прп̃бнаго оц̃а нашего іѡа́нна да-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Accept our evening prayers, O holy Lord, and grant us remission of sins, for Thou alone art He Who revealed the Resurrection unto the world.

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: маскына. въ сꙋ́б· ве· на гн̃и възвах бл̃жни· с̃· и҃· и по-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Encompass Zion, O ye people, and surround her, and give glory therein to Him Who is risen from the dead; for He is our God, Who delivered us from our iniquities.

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: ꙗ́ко тъ е́ б̃ъ нашъ· и́же ѡ̃ лести вражїа миръ избавлен:–
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Come, O ye people, let us hymn and bow down before Christ, glorifying His Resurrection from the dead; for He is our God, Who delivered the world from the deception of the enemy.

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Веселите сѧ небеса и въстрꙋбите основанїа земли· въсзъпийте горы въ веселие· се бо емманоилъ· грѣхы наша на кр̃тѣ пригвозди· и живо́ дарова· и съмр̃ть оумр̃тви· и адама въскреси· ꙗ́ко чл̃колюбець·
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Rejoice, O ye heavens, and sound the trumpets, ye foundations of the earth; break forth into singing, ye mountains, in gladness; for behold, Emmanuel nailed our sins unto the Cross, and granted life, and put death to death, and raised Adam up, for He is the Lover of mankind.

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Плътїю волею распеншаго сѧ нас ради· страдавша и погребена· и въскресша из мрт̃вых въспоемъ гл̃юще· оутверди православие цр̃ковы твое х̃е· и оумири жизнь нашꙋ· ꙗ́ко чл̃колюбець:–
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* Him Who was crucified in the flesh of His own will for our sake, Who suffered and was buried, and rose from the dead, let us hymn, saying: Establish the right belief[^6] of Thy Church, O Christ, and bring peace unto our life, for Thou art the Lover of mankind.

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Живодавному ти гробоу· прѣстоѧще недостойнїи· славословїе приносим неизреченному ти мл̃рдїю х̃е б̃е нашъ· ꙗко распятїе прїимъ и съмр̃ть безгрѣшне· да мирови дароуеши воскренїе· ꙗ́ко чл̃колюбець·
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* Standing before Thy life-giving tomb, unworthy as we are, we offer a hymn of praise unto Thine ineffable compassion, O Christ our God; for Thou, O sinless One, didst accept crucifixion and death, that Thou mightest grant the Resurrection unto the world, for Thou art the Lover of mankind.

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ[т] ц̃а оу́съ без нача́лна· и съпрѣносꙋ́щна сло́ва· из дѣ́вственыѧ оу́тро́бы проше́дша неизре́ченно· распятїе и съмр̃ть нас ради волею прїемша· и въскресша въ славѣ· въспоемъ гл̃юще· живодавче г̃и слава тобѣ· сп̃се д̃шам нашим:–
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7:* The Word, Who was begotten of the Father without beginning and is co-eternal,[^7] Who came forth ineffably from the virginal womb, and willingly accepted crucifixion and death for our sake, and is risen in glory: let us hymn Him, saying: O Lord, the Giver of life, glory to Thee, the Savior of our souls!

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: рзаите лю́дїе бж̃їи· ибо то побѣди́ враги ꙗ́ко чл̃колюбець:–
items.english_text: *Tone 1. Theotokion (Dogmatikon):* Let us hymn the Virgin Mary, the glory of the whole world, who sprang forth from mankind and gave birth unto the Master, the heavenly gate, the song of the bodiless hosts, and the adornment of the faithful; for she was shown forth as heaven and the temple of the Godhead; she, having destroyed the barrier of enmity, brought in peace and opened the Kingdom. Having her, therefore, as the anchor of faith, we have as champion the Lord Who was born of her. Be of good courage, O people of God, for He will conquer the enemies, for He is the Lover of mankind.

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Стр̃тїю твоею х̃е· ѡ̃ стр̃тен свободихом сѧ· и воскр̃нїем твоим из нетленїа избавихом сѧ· г̃и слава тобѣ·
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Tone [Tone 1]:*

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Распатїе волею принеслъ еси сп̃се· и погребенїе притерпѣвъ· въскресъ из мрт̃вых ꙗко б̃ъ нашъ разори ꙗко щедръ со противныи шатанїа силою твоею· и спенїа л̃тив ке славѧщее триднєвное твое въскрение·
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* By Thy Passion, O Christ, we were set free from passions, and by Thy Resurrection we were delivered from corruption; O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Црь ныныи за чл̃колюбїе· волею распяжеся и погребе· сего срѣтъ адъ долѣ огорчи· сего прїяша д̃ша праведных радовахоу· ада[мъ] же остави дѣ́тѧ зн жителя ꙗко преисподнї· ѡ̃ тюкако животъ смр̃тныи вкуси· како вѣкъ въ заграде· всяко ꙗко таи зволи· просвѣтити мира· въпиюща и гл̃ща· въскре́гъ подая мирови велию мл̃ть·
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Thou didst willingly accept crucifixion, O Savior, and having endured burial, Thou didst rise from the dead as our God; as One abundant in mercy, Thou didst shatter the arrogant assaults of the adversary by Thy power, granting salvation unto those who glorify Thy third-day Resurrection.

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Се исполнися ино пророче́нїе· двою бо родила еси· и по рождествѣ ꙗко прежде р̃жтва пребыва́еши· б̃ъ бо бѣ рож[е]нъ на[мъ]· тѣмже естество нетощи· н̃ж б̃гомти мл̃твъ твоих рабъ въ твоеи цр̃кви приносимыи· ꙗ́ ты не презри· н̃ж ꙗко бл̃гоꙋтробнаго своего сн̃а на рꙋках носящи· насъ твоя рабы оу̃мл̃рди· и мл̃нести сѧ д̃шам нашим:–
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Being King, out of love for mankind Thou wast willingly crucified and buried. When Hades met Thee below, it was embittered; and when the souls of the righteous received Thee, they rejoiced. And Adam, beholding Thee, the Creator, in the nethermost regions, was set free from corruption. Oh, what a marvel! How did the Life of all taste of death? How was He enclosed in a tomb, save that He willed to illumine the world, as we cry aloud and say: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Камени назнаменаноу ѡ̃ иꙋдеи· и войно страгꙋщи преч̃стое тѣло твое· въскре триднидныи сп̃се· дая всему мироу жизнь· сего ради силы нб̃ныи въпїяхоу ти жизнодавче· слава въскренїю тн х̃е· слава цр̃твїю ти· слава смотре́нїю твоему еди-
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Behold, the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled; for a Virgin hast thou given birth, and after childbirth thou remainest as before childbirth; for God was born unto us, therefore nature was not corrupted. Therefore, O Mother of God, despise not the prayers of thy servants offered in thy church; but as thou bearest Thine own compassionate Son in thine arms, have compassion upon us, thy servants, and show mercy unto our souls!

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Гаврїилоу провѣщавшу д̃вѣ и́ радость· съ гласо́мъ въплощааше сѧ всѣх вл̃ка· въ тобѣ ст̃ѣмь кивотѣ· ꙗ́коже рече праведныи дв̃дъ· яви сѧ пространѣйши нб̃съ· поносившы зижителя своего· слава всельшему сѧ въ тя· слава проше́дшомꙋ из тебе· слава свободившему нарожество твое:–
items.english_text: While the stone was sealed by the Jews, and the soldiers guarded Thine all-pure Body, Thou didst rise on the third day, O Savior, granting life unto all the world. Therefore the heavenly powers cried aloud unto Thee, O Giver of life: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O Christ! Glory to Thy Kingdom! Glory to Thy dispensation, O only Lover of mankind!

items.office: SATURDAY EVENING: VESPERS (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: на оутрни· ка· ст̃ыи и живоначалнѣи тр̃ци· гла̃ ·а̃· п̃ѣ ·а̃· ір̃мо· Твоя побѣдитель
items.english_text: When Gabriel announced unto the Virgin: Rejoice!, with his voice the Master of all became incarnate in thee, the holy Ark, as the righteous David said; thou wast shown forth more spacious than the heavens, having borne thy Creator. Glory to Him Who dwelt within thee! Glory to Him Who came forth from thee! Glory to Him Who freed our race through thy childbearing!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Единотрисъставное начало· серафими славятъ немл̃чъно· безначалной присносоущно· творечеся ꙗже ѡтчскою ꙗже ѡтчскыи н̃дль· и непостижимую· юже всякъ языкъ вѣрно славит пѣсньми:–
items.english_text: *At Matins, Canon to the Holy and Life-Creating Trinity, Tone 1. Ode 1. Heirmos: Thy victorious [right hand]...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Единьственое· и трисїянное твое явивши бж̃тво· създавъ б̃ъ чл̃ка по образу своему· и вразоумилъ еси· оумъ емоу и слово и д̃хъ давъ· ꙗко чл̃колюбець:–
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Seraphim glorify unceasingly the unoriginate and co-eternal Principle in Three Persons,[^8] the unsearchable Godhead, which every tongue faithfully glorifies with hymns.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Съвыше показалъ еси единьственоу ю· и б̃гоначалную въ тре̃ съставѣ дръжавоу ѡ̃че доспѣлъ еси· равнодѣтелно мл̃с̃ноу своему и д̃ху· въ тре̃ съставѣх въспѣваемь:–
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Manifesting Thy singular and thrice-radiant Godhead, O God, Thou didst create man according to Thine image, and didst grant him understanding, giving him mind, word, and spirit, for Thou art the Lover of mankind.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: чалнаго· и с̃на равночеленна· и д̃ха ст̃го съпрѣстолна· серафимьскы въспѣваемь· въ тр̃е́ еди́ннаго б̃а славимь· с̃· с̃· с̃· въ единствѣ покланѧема и поема· и въ трех отѣнїе ст̃ко покланѧем сѧ ꙗкоу единому:–
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* From on high Thou didst show forth the singular and divine dominion in three Hypostases, O Father, having made It equal in action unto Thy Son and Spirit; therefore in three Hypostases we hymn Thee.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Ты древле ꙗвѣ· авраамоу ꙗко ѡ̃вне сѧ трнесъставень· единѣ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The unoriginate Father, the co-equal Son, and the co-enthroned Holy Spirit, let us hymn in the manner of the Seraphim; let us glorify the One God in Trinity: Holy, Holy, Holy! Worshipped and hymned in unity, and worshipped in three Persons as One.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Ты древле ꙗвѣ· авраамоу ꙗко ѡ̃вне сѧ трнесъставень· единѣ
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: съставны естество бж̃тва· б̃гословїа истиннѣишино ѡбразно ꙗвїеси· и вѣрно поет[ь] сѧ единороднаго сн̃а· въ троици ѡц̃а и сн̃а и д̃ха ст̃го:–
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Of old Thou didst manifestly appear unto Abraham as three Hypostases in one hypostatic essence of the Godhead, prefiguring the truest theology, and the only-begotten Son is faithfully hymned in the Trinity of Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: сн̃а и д̃ха ст̃го· оусты стыми серафими тт̃о· православно и съвершенно· оусыненїе ꙗ́вествена ба па· и нас ради чл̃къ въ едино сочтана· свѣтъ ѡ свѣта· сп̃сь не измѣнїе чл̃ческаго послѣдованиа·
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With holy lips, the Seraphim glorify the unoriginate Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, right-believingly and perfectly; and for our sake as men, the Light of Light was united into one, the Savior without change following human nature.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: преест̃внаа· неизгланно паче оумы и смысла· оумныи и разумнаѧ оущества славят· трист̃ыми гласы немолчьно воспѣвающе хвалу· идїиже велѣпно дойно поетъ трисоставныи н̃гъ·
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Unity in Trinity transcendent in essence, beyond mind and understanding! Ineffably the spiritual and rational essences glorify Thee, with thrice-holy voices unceasingly offering praise, where the tri-hypostatic Hymn is fittingly sung.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: но изыде безкрѣмленныи· оулоби сѧ на безвѣчныи и едино естество и г̃ьство· ѡ̃ возлюбленїе· сп̃съ и д̃хъ ист̃е купно произыде·
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who is beyond time came forth in time without change, and the timeless One was well-pleased in one essence and lordship; O beloved Savior, and the Spirit came forth together!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Тр̃у еединице б̃е· всемира возлюбленеси· спана ре̃ онеже бл̃гоизволи· вовидениїи голубини б̃и звѣстом· ѡ̃ца себе неизпа и д̃ха не раздѣлна· трединоставленіи и совокупленіи· и покланѧема православно изволеніе бо оу ч̃лком и́же ради спасения·
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn of the Trinity, Tone 1:* O Trinity, Unity, God, beloved of all the world! In the appearance of a dove Thou didst well-pleasingly reveal the Father and Thyself and the undivided Spirit, in three Hypostases and in union, worshipped in right belief for the salvation of mankind.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Или спасение свое б̃це д̃во· въ день пришествїа его вто́ра· ꙗ́ростию да не ѡбличитъ мои таиныи прегрѣшенїи· ни да поставить мя со частию козлищь· н̃ж да оущедрит мя мл̃твами твоими· д̃во все непорочнаа·
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Behold my salvation, O Virgin Theotokos! In the day of His second coming, may He not reprove in anger my secret transgressions, nor set me with the portion of the goats; but may He have compassion on me through thy prayers, O all-immaculate Virgin!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Before all, Thou didst establish the angels in the midst of creation; by the inaccessible rays of Thy beauty and by Thy many-lighted beams, illumine those who right-believingly hymn Thee, O Trinity of single dominion!

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Father, Son, and Holy Spirit are one Divine Essence; O ye faithful, glorify the One God, divided and undivided, Creator of visible and invisible creation!

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Possessing equal dignity and power, O superessential Trinity, in the essence of Thy will, Thou art a simple and undivided Unity; do Thou, therefore, preserve us by Thy power!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Припадѣ въ вѣрно съ ср̃дца вопиюще· помилꙋи на недостойны рабы твои тр̃це прекл̃гаа· ѡ̃че и сн̃е и д̃ше ст̃ыи· оумилрдне сѧ мл̃ти не настадо свое· ст̃ажа еси· непрестанно славити тя бл̃гтыню твою:–
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast the temple of the unwaning Sun, O all-pure One, Who created the great luminaries; having taken abode in thee, O all-pure Virgin and Bride of God, deliver us now from eternal torment!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
items.slavonic_text: Б̃кобородитеннице едино ѡ̃ тр̃ца родила еси· раю прекрасныи земли сп̃сеніе· покровом ти огради и бл̃ажено воспѣвающи тя· ты бо рола еси нико прр̃цї б̃репа ты бо понесла еси иже все держаща·
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn of the Trinity, Tone 1:* Falling down in faith, crying out from the heart: Have mercy upon us, Thy unworthy servants, O most good Trinity: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit! In Thy mercy have compassion upon Thine own flock which Thou hast acquired, that we may unceasingly glorify Thee and Thy goodness!

items.slavonic_text: Словїем и сое̃стьное ѡзарение вседержителѧ б̃а і

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That Thou mightest show Thy tender mercy, O Master, Thou didst send Thy Savior into the abyss unto our lowliness, and didst re-fashion [us] unto the primal brightness; but now grant me understanding, O Divine Spirit!

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O most radiant Properties, O Father ineffably mighty in days, fill [us] with ineffable things; and, O Holy Spirit, make the man spiritual and perfect in the vision of nature, crying aloud unto the Light and Essence: O Father, Son, and God!

items.slavonic_text: Прїими хвалꙋ ѡ̃ тын со̃не донїа ѡуманше · тр̃це пресовершенаа · всѧ ѡзаряющи и просвѣщающи оумныа · бл̃гтыню и силою · тя бо славѧ непѣныꙗ силы · и мы зенїи неп̃олчныими гл̃сы вопиети · да бл̃вит тя ·

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Look down upon our prayer, O Master, Who in tri-hypostatic subsistence art the one truly glorified God; and grant comfort unto Thy servants, through the prayers of the all-pure and all-praised Mother of God!

items.english_text: *Glory... Troparion:* O Lord, have mercy on us, for in Thee have we put our trust; be not exceedingly wroth with us, neither remember our iniquities; but look upon us even now as Thou art compassionate, and deliver us from our enemies; for Thou art our God, and we are Thy people, all the work of Thy hands, and we call upon Thy name.

items.english_text: *Then the dismissal; and commemoration for the Orthodox sovereigns and people. And thereafter the reader begins Matins, and the priest says:*[^11]

items.slavonic_text: пото̃ · пр̃те поклони · г̃ · та пл̃о · ꋋслышитѧ г̃ь · др̃в · пл̃о · Г̃и силою твоею ·
items.english_text: **Priest:** Blessed is our God, always, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 1)
