items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́ко помышленіи ꙁлыими и дѣлы ѡсѫдихъ мѧ сене сп҃се · мысль ми дарꙋи ѡбращенїа
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* As a great abyss are my sins, O Christ Savior, and grievously am I submerged by mine iniquities; give me a helping hand as unto Peter, O God, and have mercy on me!

items.office: On Sunday evening, Penitential Stichera at "Lord, I have cried". Work of Lord Joseph, Tone 1.
items.slavonic_text: б҃же · да ꙋкоутьнѣисїа · бл̃годѣтелю благыи помилоуи мѧ :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Because by evil thoughts and deeds I have condemned myself, O Savior: grant me the thought of return O God, that having turned [from evil], O good Benefactor, have mercy on me!

items.office: On Sunday evening, Penitential Stichera at "Lord, I have cried". Work of Lord Joseph, Tone 1.
items.slavonic_text: мч҃нченъ · Мл҃твами г҃и всѣстыхъ мч̃н̃цъ · твои мирь дажь намъ · и помилоуи ны ꙗко единь щедрь :~
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* By the prayers of all the holy martyrs, O Lord, grant us Thy peace, and have mercy on us, as the only compassionate One!

items.office: On Sunday evening, Penitential Stichera at "Lord, I have cried". Work of Lord Joseph, Tone 1.
items.slavonic_text: сла̃ · і ны · б̃ · Чинъмь чн̃иль радованїе · и на ꙁемли чл̃комь крѣпкаа помощнице, прѣчистаа д҃во · сп҃си и аиже къ текѣ прибѣгающихъ · ꙗко на тѧ ꙋпованїе имам̃ б̃це къ сложихомъ :~
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Thou art the joy of angelic ranks, and upon earth the mighty helper of men, O all-pure Virgin; save those who flee unto thee, for in thee have we placed our hope, O Theotokos!

items.slavonic_text: Иже прѣжде вѣкъ ѿ ѡц̃а рожьшꙋ сѧ бж҃їю слову въплъщьшꙋ же сѧ ѡ̃ д̃вы мр҃їа · прїидѣте поклонимь сѧ · распѧтїе бо притръпѣвь · и погребенїе предаеть сѧ ꙗко самъ въсхотѣ · и въскр҃съ иꙁ мр҃твыихъ сп҃си мѧ блоудѧщаго сн̃чл҃ка :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Come, let us worship God the Word, begotten of the Father before the ages, and incarnate of the Virgin Mary; for having endured the Cross, He surrendered Himself unto burial as He Himself willed; and having risen from the dead, He hath saved me, a wandering man!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: Х̃с сп҃съ нашь е̃же на ны рѫкописанїе на кр̃тѣ пригвоꙁдивъ растрѫꙁа съмръти дръжавꙋ оупраꙁниль е̃си · тѣмь же покланѧемь сѧ, трид̃невному его въскресенноy :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* Christ our Savior, having nailed unto the Cross the handwriting that was against us, tore it asunder and abolished the dominion of death. Therefore we worship His third-day Resurrection!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: С̃ъ архагг҃лы въспоемъ х̃во въскр҃сенїе · тъи бо е̃ иꙁбавитель и сп̃съ дшамь нашимь · въ славѣ страшнѣи и крѣпцѣи силѣ · пакы грѧде сѫдити мироу егоже съꙁда :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* With the archangels let us hymn the Resurrection of Christ; for He is the Redeemer and the Savior of our souls, and in fearful glory and mighty power He comes again to judge the world which He hath fashioned!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: гл҃аше женамъ · приидѣте и видите идеже лежа г̃ь · въскресе бо ꙗкоже рече · ꙗко въсесиленъ · сего ради покланѣем ти сѧ · единомꙋ бе̃съмр҃тноумꙋ · жизнодавче хе̃ помилꙋи ны :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* Thee, Who wast crucified and buried, an angel proclaimed as Master, and said unto the women: Come and see where the Lord lay; for He is risen as He said, as almighty! Therefore we worship Thee, the only Immortal One: O Life-giver Christ, have mercy on us!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: Кр̃тѡм твоимъ х̃е оупраꙁниль е̃си иже ѡ дрѣва клѧтвꙋ · и погребенїемь своимь оумрътвиль е̃си съмр҃ти дрьжавꙋ · въскръсением же своимь просвѣтиль е̃си ро̃дъ чл̃чьскы · сего ради въпїемь ти, бл̃г̃телю х̃е б҃же нашь слава тебѣ :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 5:* By Thy Cross, O Christ, Thou hast abolished the curse of the tree; and by Thy burial Thou hast put to death the dominion of death; and by Thy Resurrection Thou hast enlightened the race of mankind. Therefore we cry aloud unto Thee: O Benefactor, Christ our God, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ́твръꙁоша ти сѧ г̃и страхомъ врата съмр҃тнаꙗ · вратарїе же адовы видѣвше тѧ оужасоша сѧ · врата бо мѣднаꙗ сътре · и верѣꙗ желѣꙁныꙗ съкроуши · и иꙁведе ны ѡ̃ тмы и сѣни съмр҃тныꙗ · и ꙋꙁы наша растрѫꙁа :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 6:* Unto Thee, O Lord, the gates of death opened in fear, and the gatekeepers of Hades, seeing Thee, were terrified; for Thou didst shatter the brazen gates and crush the iron bars, and didst lead us out from darkness and the shadow of death, and tore asunder our chains!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: Сп̃сенꙋю пѣснь поюще · иꙁ оустъ въсылаемь · приидѣте въси въ домь гн̃ь · въꙁъпїемь гл҃юще · иже на дрѣвѣ распѧтыи сем · и иꙁ мр҃твыихъ въскр̃съ · сыи въ лонѣ бж҃їи ѡчисти грѣхы наша :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7:* Chanting a saving hymn, we send it forth from our mouths: Come, all ye, into the house of the Lord, let us cry aloud, saying: O Thou Who wast crucified upon the tree and art risen from the dead, Who art in the bosom of God, cleanse our sins!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: Преиде сѣнь ꙁаконнаꙗ · бл̃г̃ти пришедши · ꙗкоже бо коупина ѡпалаема не съгараше · тако дв̃аа роди и дв̃ою прѣбы · въ мѣсто стлъпа ѡгненаго праведное въсїꙗ слънце · въ мѣсто мѡѵсеа х̃с · сп̃сенїе дшамь нашимь :~

items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* The shadow of the law hath passed away when grace arrived; for as the bush burned with fire yet was not consumed, so as a virgin thou didst give birth and didst remain a virgin. In place of a pillar of fire, the Sun of righteousness hath shone forth; in place of Moses, Christ, the Salvation of our souls!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: Въскр̃сенїе твое х̃е сп҃се · всю просвѣти въселенѫꙗ · и приꙁва свое съꙁданїе · въсесилне г̃и слава тебѣ :~

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: Въскр̃сенїе твое х̃е сп҃се · всю просвѣти въселенѫꙗ · и приꙁва свое съꙁданїе · въсесилне г̃и слава тебѣ :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thy Resurrection, O Christ Savior, hath enlightened all the universe and recalled Thine own creation; O almighty Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: ꙁданїю ѡ́браꙁъ иꙁмѣнѧше сѧ · и воини беꙁчл̃чїе покаꙁающе · ребра твоꙗ прободоша · еврен печатлѣти гроба просиша · невѣдоуще твою власть · ꙁа млр̃дїе щедротъ, въспрїемль тридневное въскрсенїе · г̃и слава тебѣ :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* When Thou, O Christ, wast nailed unto the Cross the form of creation was changed; and the soldiers, displaying inhumanity, pierced Thy side; and the Jews asked that the tomb be sealed, not knowing Thy power. But for the tender mercy of Thy compassions, having accepted a three-day burial and Resurrection, O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: Агг҃лъ оубо ѡ́радоуи сѧ прѣжде ꙁачатїа ти г̃и · бл̃годатнѣи принесь · агг҃лъ же камень славнаго гроба твоего · въ твое въскрсенїе ѡ́вали · ѡ́вь оубо въ печали мѣсто веселїа ѡ́браꙁы къꙁвѣщаꙗ · съ же въ съмр҃ти мѣсто · вл̃коу жизнодавца проповѣда намъ · тѣ въпиемь ти · бл̃г̃телю въсѣчьскыимь, г̃и слава тебѣ :~
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* An angel brought "Rejoice" unto her that is full of grace before Thy conception, O Lord; and an angel also rolled away the stone of Thy glorious tomb at Thy Resurrection. The one indeed proclaimed signs of joy in place of sorrow; while the other preached unto us the Master and Life-giver in place of death. Therefore we cry aloud unto Thee: O Benefactor of all, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: сла̃ і н̃нѣ · б̃ · Ѡ чюдеси новаго · паче въсѣ древнихъ чюдесь, кто бо поꙁна мт҃рь беꙁ моужа раждающѫ · и на рѫкоу носѧщоу, иже всю тварь съдръжащаго · бж҃їе е̃ слово рожьшее сѧ, егоже ꙗко младенца прѣчистаа · на рꙋкоу своею поносивши · и мт҃рне дръꙁновенїе к нему оуимаꙗщи, непрѣстан молащи ѡ чьтоущихъ тѧ · оущедрити и сп̃сти дша наша :~
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* O new wonder, greater than all ancient wonders! For who hath known a mother giving birth without a man, and carrying upon her arm Him Who upholds all creation? It is the Word of God that was born, Whom as an infant, O all-pure one, thou didst bear in thine arms; and having maternal boldness toward Him, cease not to pray for those who honor thee, to have compassion and save our souls!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: Егда съниде къ съмрътн животъ бе̃съмртныи, тогда ада оумрътви блистанїемь бж҃тва · егда же оумеръшлаа ѿ прѣнеподнѣхъ въскрѣси · въсѧ силы нб̃ныꙗ въпїꙗхоути · жизнодавче х̃е б҃е слава тебѣ :~
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Troparion, Tone 2:*[^38]

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: в̃ сла̃ і ны̃ б̃ · Въсѧ паче оума въсѧ прѣславна · твоꙗ бц̃е таинства · чт̃отою ꙁапечатлѣнна ·
items.english_text: When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life Immortal, then didst Thou slay Hades with the brilliance of the Godhead; and when Thou didst raise up the dead from the nethermost depths, all the heavenly powers cried aloud: O Life-giver, Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.office: On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried", we set 8 verses, and sing resurrectional stichera, Tone 2:*[^36]
items.slavonic_text: и дѣвьствомь хранима, мт҃и раꙁоумѣ сѧ неложьнаꙗ · б҃а рожѣши истиннаго · того моли сп̃сти сѧ дшамь нашимъ :~
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* All beyond thought, all most glorious are thy mysteries, O Theotokos! Sealed in purity and preserved in virginity, thou art recognized to be the true Mother, having given birth unto the true God; entreat Him to save our souls!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: канѡ · ст҃ѣи · и живоначальнѣи трци · гла̃ ·в̃· пѣ̃ ·а̃· ірм̃съ :~ въ глоубинѣ потопивь древлє фа :~
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, Tone 2. Ode 1. Heirmos: In the deep He submerged of old Pharaoh...*[^39]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Едино е̃ство · въ двѣ е̃сществѣ х̃а исповѣдоуемь · ѿ ѡц̃а прѣжде вѣкъ роженаа не сътворена · въ послѣднаꙗ лѣта беꙁ сѣмене ѡ̃ д̃вы чистꙑꙗ въплъщше сѧ · и ѡбновившихъ встанїемь ро̃дъ чл҃чьскыи :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* One essence in two essences we confess Christ: begotten of the Father before the ages and not made, in the last times incarnate without seed of the pure Virgin, and having renewed the human race by His rising!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Странно и дивно рожество бывшее, прѣже вѣкъ · ѿ ѡц̃а беꙁ начална · и пакы ѿ д̃вы беꙁ ѡц̃а · иже нб̃нїи конс съ страхом славѧть · и мы ꙁемнїи рж҃тво твое поемь · и въстанїю твоу поклоним сѧ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Strange and marvelous was the birth before the ages from the unoriginate Father, and again from the Virgin without father, which the heavenly hosts glorify with fear; and we the earthly hymn Thy Nativity, and worship Thy rising!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: И конс тѡчннкь ѿ корене е̃си, ѿ ѡц̃ь сꙑи въиновень, иже къ сн̃ꋋ н̃бс твѣтѣль единосꙋщномꙋ бж҃твꙋ и трисличнꙋ · ср̃дцꙋ моемꙋ свѣтлость причѧстїемь просвѣти · б̃годѣтельнымь ѡ́ꙁаренїемь :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Thou art the source from the root, being the cause from the Father unto the Son... unto the consubstantial and three-personed Godhead: enlighten my heart with the brilliance of communion, by Thy beneficent radiance!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: На тѧ въꙁложи надежоу мою · и д̃шꙋ ѡкаꙗннѫꙗ · даи же ми рѫкоу помощи вл̃чце · ѿ тли изве̃ сп҃си млр̃дїемь :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* In thee have I placed my hope and my wretched soul; give me a helping hand, O Sovereign Lady: deliver me from corruption and save me by thy tender mercy!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ ·г̃· ірм̃ Процвѣла е̃сть поустынїа ꙗко кринь :~
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: The desert hath blossomed as a lily...*[^40]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Едино е̃сщество въ тре̃свонетѣ б̃е славимь · не раꙁдѣлнѣи троицѣ покланѣем сѧ · ѡц̃оу и сн̃оу и ст̃моудх҃ꙋ · тако дръжити и хранить, беꙁ съблаꙁна ро̃дъ хр̃тїаньскыи :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* We glorify the one essence in the thrice-holy God; we worship the undivided Trinity: the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, that It may uphold and preserve the Christian race without stumbling!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Оутверди на камени вѣры · и раꙁьшири любовію твоею, поучи мое ср҃дца рабы твоихь · Единнице трисличнаꙗ · ты бо е̃си б҃ъ нашь · на тѧ же оуповающе не постыдим сѧ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* From the unoriginate Father the Word descended into her, taking upon Himself a twofold nature, becoming at once God and man that He might renew man by His Resurrection!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ́чаꙗхъ сѧ прѣчистаа своеꙗ жиꙁни вл̃чце · сквръно пожихъ на ꙁемли · въ словесѣхъ же и въ дѣлѣхъ прѣ тобою клаю сѧ · помилоуи мѧ въпїю ти · не ѡ́връꙁи мене къ врѣмѧ скръби :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Establish upon the rock of faith, and broaden by Thy love the teaching of my heart, [and] of Thy servants, O three-personed Unity; for Thou art our God, and hoping in Thee we shall not be put to shame!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Прѣстаа тр҃це помилꙋи иихже съꙁда иꙁбави ѡгнѧ и вьсѧкого ѡсоужденїа · вьсѧ бо можеши ꙗко щедры и нѣсть ндиного мл̃тивъ · тѣмь припадае̃м ти въпїюще · съгрѣшихъ прости чл҃колюбче :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* I have despaired of my life, O all-pure Sovereign Lady; vilely have I lived upon earth, both in words and in deeds, and I bow down before thee: have mercy on me, I cry unto thee; cast me not away in the time of sorrow!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Дѣво прѣчистаа помилꙋи рабы своꙗ · иꙁбави ѡгнѧ и вьсѧкоꙗ мꙋкы · в нощи и въ дни въпїющиꙗ · къ сн҃оу твоему прѣпѣтаꙗ · не прѣꙁри стадо свое, х̃е мл҃твами рождьшаꙗ тѧ :~
items.english_text: O Most Holy Trinity, have mercy on those whom Thou hast fashioned; deliver them from fire and all condemnation; for Thou canst do all things, being compassionate, and there is none so merciful. Therefore we fall down before Thee, crying: Forgive those who have sinned, O Lover of mankind!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ ·д̃· ірм̃съ · Пою тѧ слоухомь г̃и :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O all-pure Virgin, have mercy on thy servants; deliver from fire and every torment those who cry day and night unto thy Son, O all-hymned one; despise not Thy flock, O Christ, through the prayers of her that bare Thee!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Съвръшенъ ѡ̃ съвръшенаго · б҃ъ ѡ̃ б҃а рожденъ а не сътворенъ · ни по лѣтноимь и рожьствомь прѣжде вѣкъ · иꙁволи плъть быти, не тр҃ти причѧсти сѧ · и въскр̃се тридневно :~
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: I hear Thee by report, O Lord...*[^42]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Въ единьствѣ тр҃цоу славимь, и тр҃цꙋ въ единьствѣ · бж҃тво не раꙁдѣлно · ѡц̃а съ беꙁначална · и сп҃са прѣстолна · съ прѣст̃ымь дх҃ѡмь да прославимь :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Perfect from Perfect, God begotten of God and not made, not in time, and born before the ages; He was pleased to become flesh, partook of incorruption, and rose on the third day!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Единьства началнаго · и несвѣтна въ тр̃илица · въспѣваемы ꙗко видѣнїемь имꙋща ·
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In Unity let us glorify the Trinity, and the Trinity in Unity, an undivided Godhead: the Father with the unoriginate, and the Savior co-enthroned, with the All-Holy Spirit let us glorify!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: раꙁдѣлна съставы · иж оубо съединенна и не раꙁдѣлна бж҃твом и славою :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* In singing the unoriginate and unapproachable Unity in three Persons, having, as it were, a vision distinct in hypostases, yet united and undivided in Godhead and glory!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Нескврънаа вл̃чце · съ трепетомь въспѣвае̃м ти · оуслыши г̃ла мои, и раждени бѣсовьское помраченїе чистаа · на ма въстающее · ты бо ми е̃си ꙁастоупница и прѣстателница · и сп̃сенїе с̃таа :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O undefiled Sovereign Lady, with trembling we hymn thee: give ear unto my voice, and drive away the demonic darkening, O pure one, that rises up against me; for thou art my protector and mediatress, and holy salvation!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Цр҃тво едино и господьство, въ трехь е̃събьствѣхь · не раꙁдѣлно прославимь, ѡц̃ь бо беꙁначально породи единороднаго сн̃а · и съпрненосꙋщна · егоже въставша иꙁ мр҃твыихъ прославимь :~
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Enlighten...*[^43]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Съ архагг҃лы въспоимь въ рїніе тж̃атр̃цꙋ · не раꙁдѣлнꙋ е̃ж[е] съ бж҃твомь · своиствы же инꙗемы раꙁдѣленъ · ѡц̃а и сн̃а и ст̃го дх҃а · во тресовершеньїе жществѣ слави, ѡц̃а и сн̃а и ст̃го дх҃а :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* One kingdom and dominion in three hypostases let us glorify without division; for the Father unoriginately begat the Only-begotten Son, co-eternal and consubstantial, Whom, having risen from the dead, let us glorify!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Мѡѵсеов[о] коупинѣ · въ виденнои тьмѣ ꙗко ꙗвисѧ · аг҃глъ наречесѧ ѡц̃ее слово · еже к намь проꙗвлѧꙗ пришествїе егоже радни вѣпро къꙁвѣстилъ е̃си · дръжавоу бг҃оначална · единого трисъставнаго :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* With the archangels let us sing praise unto the Trinity, undivided in Godhead, yet divided in known personal properties: the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, in the thrice-perfect Godhead glorify the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Надежа въсѣмь концемь ꙁемли · бл̃г̃венаа бц̃е д̃во · въ врѣмѧ живота моего · богатыхъ щедротъ не лиши мене, и ж̃ ѡбилно подаи же ми твое млр̃дїе · да и аꙁъ съ вѣрою покланѣꙗсѧ ѡ́браꙁоу твоему прѣчистаа :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* In Moses' bush, as He appeared in visible darkness, the Father's Word was called an angel, manifesting His coming unto us, for Whose sake Thou hast proclaimed the dominion of the divine origin of the One in three hypostases!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ ·ѕ̃· ірм̃ь · Въ беꙁднѣ грѣховнѣ ѡдержимь :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Hope of all the ends of the earth, O blessed Virgin Theotokos: in the time of my life deprive me not of rich compassions, but abundantly grant me thy tender mercy, that I also with faith may venerate thine image, O all-pure one!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Единь б̃ъ въ трехъ своиствѣхъ лици раꙁдѣлѧемь · е̃тъствомь же не раꙁдѣлаемь ·
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Held fast in the abyss of sin...*[^44]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтъ единь въ трехъ лицехь · въ ѡц̃и и сн̃и и ст̃мь дсѣ · трїе не раꙁдѣлно · и треми своиствы славимь, и въ едино покланѣемо вѣди :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* One God in three properties, distinct in persons, yet undivided in essence giving life unto the ends [of the earth] by His Nativity!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Оумь оубо не роженыи ѡц̃ь, и ѡ́браꙁно прѣмꙋдро просвѣщаꙗ сѧ на слово же беꙁначално съе̃стътвъныи сн̃ь · и дх҃ъ съпрѣстолныи · ꙗже въ двѣ е̃сщестѣ к словомь · съꙁдавшаго воплощенїе :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* One Light in three Persons, in the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, three indivisibly, and glorified in three properties, and known as worshipped in unity!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтодавца мирови порождшиꙗ, ѡмрачноую ми дш̃ꙋ просвѣти г̃же моли х̃а распѧтаго и въскресъша иꙁ гроба тридневно :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* The unbegotten Mind is the Father, and wisely shining forth as the image is the Word, the co-essential unoriginate Son; and the co-enthroned Spirit, [Who wrought] the Incarnation of the Creator in two essences according to the Word!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: сѣ̃ гла̃ ·в̃· В полоунощн къстающе · ср̃ъдцемь и ꙋсты аг҃гльскѫꙗ пѣснь приносити тебѣ · просвѣти на въскрсенїемь своимь · днь великыꙗ радости · днь просвѣщенїа · сп̃си на поющихъ тѧ тр̃це с̃таа помилоуи д̃ша наша :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having given birth unto the Light-giver of the world, enlighten my darkened soul, O Lady; entreat Christ Who was crucified and rose from the tomb on the third day!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: сла̃ і н̃нѣ б̃ѡ · Достоино поет тѧ бц̃е марїе всеꙗ твари · ꙋмъ же мень постигноути не можетъ похвалити тѧ достоино, ѡ́гнь бо бж҃твъныи въселисѧ в тѧ · попали наша прѣгрѣшенїа · и сп̃си поющаꙗ тѧ :~
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^45]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ ·з̃· ірм̃ь · Бг҃опротивноє велє :~
items.english_text: Rising at midnight, with heart and lips we offer an angelic hymn unto Thee: enlighten us by Thy Resurrection; in the day of great joy, the day of enlightenment, save us who sing unto Thee, O Holy Trinity, have mercy on our souls!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Едино е̃ство три оупостасное · прѣст̃а тр҃це единосѫщнаа · нами почитаема · истока бж҃твнаго ѡ́расли бгосадна · съвръшено не раꙁлоучно · ѡц̃ь и сн̃ь и дх҃ъ съпокланѣемы :~
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* All creation worthily hymns thee, O Virgin Mary Theotokos; yet human mind cannot attain to praise thee worthily, for the divine fire made its abode in thee: burn up our transgressions, and save those who hymn thee!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Прѣсвѣтлади ꙁарѧми ѡ́сїаеми · прѣстаа тр҃це во едином дєржавѣ сохравни твоа пѣвца ·
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The godless command...*[^46]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Прѣсвѣтлади ꙁарѧми ѡ́сїаеми · прѣстаа тр҃це во едином дєржавѣ сохравни твоа пѣвца ·
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* One essence in three hypostases, O Most Holy consubstantial Trinity, venerated by us, branches planted by God from the divine Source, perfectly inseparable: Father, Son, and Spirit, worshipped together!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: ѿ съпротивныхъ настоѧнїи · да тѧ непрестанно славимь · ѡц̃е и сн̃е и д̃ше ст̃ыи · въ едином бж҃твѣ прославлѣемыи :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Illumined by all-radiant beams, O Most Holy Trinity, in one dominion preserve Thy singers from adverse assaults, that we may unceasingly glorify Thee: O Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, glorified in one Godhead!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Тредлиственїи бг҃ословѧще · единаго г̃ьства славꙋ · серафимь прѣстоеть страхѡ́раколѣпно, трисъставное славѧть бж҃тво · синми же добрѣ тѣтоующе поемь · ѡц̃а и сн̃а и ст̃аго дх̃а :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Theologizing the three-leaved glory of the one Lordship, the Seraphim stand before Thee with awe-inspired reverence, glorifying the three-hypostatic Godhead; with them, rightly rejoicing, we sing: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Ты хр̃тїанѡ́м е̃си прибѣжище ст̃аа · ꙁабрало же и покровъ бж̃твенын, ꙁастоупница въсѣм намь · любовїю поющимь тѧ · иꙁбави бл̃гаа ѿ страстен рабы своꙗ · да тѧ поемь и бл̃г̃вимь ѡц̃ь наши бл̃г̃вень е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou art the refuge of Christians, O holy one, a rampart and divine protection, protectress unto all of us who hymn thee with love: deliver Thy servants from passions, O good one, that we may hymn thee and bless: Blessed art Thou, [O God] of our fathers!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ ·и̃· і рм̃ь · Пещь ѻ́гн енаинога :~
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: The fiery furnace once...*[^47]

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Т р̃іе̃сътнаꙗ и неесъꙁданнаꙗ, творителнаа вѣдн · ѡц̃е и сн̃е и д̃ше ст̃ыи · е̃юже състоитъ сѧ всѧ тварь · словомь бж̃їимь съблюдаема · тѣмь ѡбнови первоꙁданнаго, въскресенїемь своимь :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Knowing the uncreated and creative Trinity in three hypostases: O Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, by Whom all creation subsists, preserved by the word of God; therefore renew the first-formed [Adam] by Thy Resurrection!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Самовластнаа тр̃це · и прѣсъвръшенаꙗ словомь · въсѧ ѿ небытїа е̃стъворша · дх҃ѡмь ѡживлѧюще · того бѡ́ ради съниде иꙁбавити родъ чл̃чъ, въстанїем тридневныимь :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O sovereign and all-perfect Trinity, having brought all things by the Word out of non-being, giving life by the Spirit: for his sake Thou didst descend to deliver the human race by the third-day rising!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Неврѣдни прѣславнїи ѻ́троци · неизмѣнныи и живыи ѡ́браꙁъ бини видѣвше · посрѣ пламени поѧхоу · ѡсоущественаа поꙗет сѧ тварь :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Unharmed, the most glorious children, having seen the immutable and living image of God, sang in the midst of the flame: Let the consubstantial creation sing!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: въсѣхъ на пѣсньное славѧщихъ тѧ въ вѣкы :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Him before Whom all things tremble, thou hast carried upon thine arms, O pure Virgin, and dost nurse Him: a strange mystery and awesome marvel, that of thee was born the Creator of Adam and my God; entreat Him, O pure one, to save all who in song glorify Thee unto ages!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ ·ѳ̃· і рм̃ь · Ꙗ же прѣже слънца свѣтилни :~
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: The Lord, Who is co-unoriginate with the Father...*

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Въсѣми владѧщили · и въсѧ съдръжѧщаꙗ · тр̃це прѣсвѣтлаꙗ, просвѣти молитвами ѡ́мрачьнѫѫ ми д̃шѫ · слове съ беꙁначалныи раꙁдрѣши моꙗ съгрѣшенїа · да прѣстое въскресенїе твое славѧщии величаемь :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ruling over all and holding all things together, O most radiant Trinity, through prayers enlighten my darkened soul; O Word Who art unoriginate, absolve my transgressions, that glorifying Thy holy Resurrection, we may magnify Thee!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Слово̃м же съставилъ е̃си ѿче прѣж̃дре · и дх̃ѡмь оучьстыхь, небо же и ꙁемлꙗ и въсѧ въꙁдꙋшнаꙗ · ѡживилъ е̃си слꙋжебныꙗ д̃хы · чловѣка же рѫкама сътвори · распѧтїе волею прѣтръпѣ, въстанїем ѡбнови е̃стъство наше :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By the Word Thou hast established [all things], O Father, in wisdom, and by the Holy Spirit: heaven and earth and all the airborne creatures; Thou hast quickened the ministering spirits, and formed man with Thine own hands; willingly enduring crucifixion, by Thy rising Thou hast renewed our nature!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣтне р̃ъдца поющихъ тѧ трнелънечныи б̃е · трисиꙗнныи д̃ше свѣтомь твоимь подаи же рабѡ́мь своимь · иже всѣмь ꙁнаати и видѣти твоꙗ хотѣнїа, бл̃го е̃не съвръшеное · и величит ти твою мл̃ть :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O God of threefold light, enlighten the hearts of those who hymn Thee; O Holy Spirit of three rays, by Thy light grant unto Thy servants that all may know and behold Thy will, which is good and perfect, and magnify Thy mercy!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Спени д̃ше спасенїе · ѿ всѣкоꙗ напасти и ѡꙁлобленїа · иже во трех лицѣх во̃спѣваемь и неизреченныи · е̃динствени и всесилне, свое стадо съхрани бц̃е ради иꙁбави :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Grant salvation of the soul from every calamity and distress, O Thou Who art praised in three Persons, ineffable, unique, and almighty: preserve Thine own flock, and deliver [us] for the sake of the Theotokos!

items.office: SUNDAY MIDNIGHT OFFICE (TONE 2)
items.slavonic_text: Т а до̃стоиное ꙗко вън по томь тр̃тое · по ѿче нашъ · тр̃орѣ · писаны по троичнѣ · пръваго гласа · и ѻ́кт̃ее · в н̃е на оутрни · на б̃ъ г̃ь тр̃о гла̃ в̃ · Егда сниде къ съмр̃ти · в̃ · и по ве̃р̃ни ст̃ра · и аꙁа̃ · та̃ по пр̃ъвом с̃тихолѡ̃ · с̃ѣ · гла̃ в̃ · Бл̃гоѡ́браꙁныи їѡ́сифь · съ кр̃та сне̃мь прѣчнстое тѣло твое · плащанницею чистою
items.english_text: *Then: It is truly meet... as [usual on Sunday]. After that, Trisagion. After Our Father, the troparia written after the Trinity [canon] of the First Tone, and the litany.*[^48]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Т а до̃стоиное ꙗко вън по томь тр̃тое · по ѿче нашъ · тр̃орѣ · писаны по троичнѣ · пръваго гласа · и ѻ́кт̃ее · в н̃е на оутрни · на б̃ъ г̃ь тр̃о гла̃ в̃ · Егда сниде къ съмр̃ти · в̃ · и по ве̃р̃ни ст̃ра · и аꙁа̃ · та̃ по пр̃ъвом с̃тихолѡ̃ · с̃ѣ · гла̃ в̃ · Бл̃гоѡ́браꙁныи їѡ́сифь · съ кр̃та сне̃мь прѣчнстое тѣло твое · плащанницею чистою
items.english_text: *On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: ѡ́вивъ, и вънꙗми, въ гробѣ новѣ ꙁакрывь положи · и́жь въ третїи д̃нь въскрес̃ь · подаꙗ мирови велїю мл̃ть :~
items.english_text: The noble Joseph, taking down Thy most pure Body from the Cross, wrapped it in a clean shroud and with sweet spices laid it closed in a new tomb; but on the third day Thou didst rise, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Д̃ва б̃ѡ · К̃то видѣ или кто слыша · м̃трь беꙁ мꙋжа ражающне съдѣтелꙗ своего, и доиши дающаго пищꙋ въсѣкои плъти · ѡ̃ чюдо прѣсто̃лъ хероувимьскыи ꙗвисѧ чрѣво твое б̃це · ѡ́брадованнаꙗ моли сѧ ѡ̃ д̃шахь нашихь :~
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Who has seen or who has heard a mother without a man bearing her Creator, and nursing Him Who gives food unto all flesh? O marvel! The Cherubic throne has thy womb appeared to be, O Theotokos; O joyful one, pray for our souls!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: И а к̃ · с̃тихолѡ̃ · с̃ѣ г̃ла в̃ · Мѵ́роносицамь женамь · при гробѣ прѣставы аг̃г̃ль въпїаше · мѵ́ро мр̃твымъ е̃ достоино · х̃с же истлѣнїоу ꙗвисѧ ѡтоуждь · и̃жь въспїнте поюще · ꙗко въскрес̃ь · подаꙗ мирови велїа мл̃ть :~
items.english_text: *And after the second stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^50]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Д̃ва · с̃ла і н̃нѣ б̃ѡ · Законъ иꙁбѣгше е̃стъвныхь · бж̃твъномꙋ р̃жтвꙋ · д̃вьство съвъкоупила е̃си · ты бѡ́ роди е̃дина рождешаго сѧ прѣже вѣкь беꙁ лѣтно, тѣм же тѧ бц̃оу величаемь :~
items.english_text: Unto the myrrh-bearing women standing by the tomb, the Angel cried aloud: Myrrh is fitting for the dead, but Christ has shown Himself a stranger to corruption! Cry aloud singing that He is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: ѵпакои · По стр̃ти ишеше на гробъ · помаꙁати тѣло твое жены х̃е б̃е · видѣша аг̃г̃ла во гробѣ и оужасоша · гла̃ бо слышаахѫ ѡ̃ него · ꙗко въскресъ подаꙗ мирови велїю мл̃ть :~
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* Escaping the laws of nature by thy divine childbearing, thou hast united virginity [with motherhood]; for thou alone didst bear the One Who was timelessly begotten of the Father before ages: therefore we magnify thee as Theotokos!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: ст̃енна г̃ла в̃ а̃нтїи а̃ · На н̃бо ѻ́чи поущаю ср̃дца моего · к тебѣ сп̃се сп̃си мѧ твоею сїанїе :~
items.english_text: *Hypakoe:* After the Passion, the women going to the tomb to anoint Thy body, O Christ God, saw an Angel in the tomb and were amazed; for they heard a voice from him, that He is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Помл̃оуи на · съгрѣшити ти много на ве̃кы часъ ѡ̃ х̃е мои · даи же ми ѡ́браꙁь · преже конца покаати к тебѣ :~
items.english_text: *Degrees, Tone 2. Antiphon 1:*[^51]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: ст̃ы д̃хѡмь · е̃же цр̃твовати побл̃е · ѡ́сщ̃ити и по̃внꙁати тварь · б̃гъ бо е̃сть е̃диносѫщень ѻ́ц̃оу и̃ слову :~
items.english_text: Unto heaven I lift up the eyes of my heart: unto Thee, O Savior, save me by Thine illumination!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: ст̃ы д̃хѡмь · е̃же цр̃твовати побл̃е · ѡ́сщ̃ити и по̃внꙁати тварь · б̃гъ бо е̃сть е̃диносѫщень ѻ́ц̃оу и̃ слову :~
items.english_text: Have mercy on us who sin against Thee greatly at every hour, O my Christ; grant me the manner of repentance before the end!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: ст̃ы д̃хѡмь · е̃же цр̃твовати побл̃е · ѡ́сщ̃ити и по̃внꙁати тварь · б̃гъ бо е̃сть е̃диносѫщень ѻ́ц̃оу и̃ слову :~
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now...:* Unto the Holy Spirit it belongs to reign, to sanctify, and to shake creation; for He is God, consubstantial with the Father and the Word!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: А́ще не г̃ь бы быль въ насъ · кто доволень цѣль съхранень быти · ѿ врага коупно · и ч̃лкооубїица :~
items.english_text: If the Lord had not been in us, who could have been kept whole from the enemy and man-slayer?

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙁꙋбѡ́мь ихъ · не прѣдаи же сп̃се своего раба · ꙗко вьць ѡ́браꙁѡ́мь на мл̃а подвиꙁающиисѧ · и́бо враꙁи мои :~
items.english_text: Unto their teeth surrender not Thy servant, O Savior; for like sheep they move against me, for they are my enemies!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: С̃тмоу д̃хоу · Живоначалїа и ч̃ть · всѧ бѡ́ съꙁданнаꙗ · ꙗко б̃ъ сыи дръжеть · и съблюдаетъ ѿ ѻ́ц̃ни съ сн̃ом же :~
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now...:* Unto the Holy Spirit belong the origin of life and honor; for as being God He upholds and preserves all created things by the Father through the Son!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: а̃нтїи · г̃ · Надѣюще сѧ на г̃а · оуподобниша горѣ ст̃ѣи · иже никаже по̃вижѫтсѧ · напастьми вражьныим :~
items.english_text: They who trust in the Lord are like the holy mountain, who shall in no wise be shaken by the assaults of the enemy!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Въ беꙁаконни рѫкы своихь · да не простроутъ · бж̃твнѣиживоущеи · не дастъ бѡ́ х̃с жеꙁла на жрѣбїи свои :~
items.english_text: In iniquities let not those who live divinely stretch forth their hands; for Christ will not give the rod unto His inheritance!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: С̃ты д̃хѡмь · Точитсѧ въсѣка прѣмоудрость · ѿсоудоу · бл̃годать а̃пли · и́ стр̃тьми вѣнчаются моученици и пр̃рци кысѧть :~
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now...:* By the Holy Spirit every wisdom flows: thence grace unto the Apostles, and by sufferings the martyrs are crowned and the prophets see!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: пр̃о г̃ла в̃ · Въстани г̃и б̃е мои · ст̃и · Г̃и б̃е мои на тѧ оуповахъ · Въсѣко дыханіе · еѵ̃лїе · въскръсное · Въскресенїе х̃во видѣвше · ѱалѡ́мь · н̃ · Молитвоу н̃дл̃е · М̃литвъ ради а̃постоль · і н̃нѣ · Мл̃твъ ради бц̃а :~
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 2: Arise, O Lord my God... Verse: O Lord my God, in Thee have I put my hope. Let every breath praise the Lord. Resurrection Gospel. Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ. Psalm 50. Prayer of the Sunday. Through the intercessions of the Apostles... Both now... Through the intercessions of the Theotokos...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: в н̃е · ка̃ · въскр̃ныи · твореніе коꙁмы инока · гла̃ в̃
items.english_text: *On Sunday, Resurrection Canon, work of Cosmas the Monk, Tone 2:*[^52]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ а̃ ірм̃ь · Въ глоубинѣ потопи древле · фараѡ́нитьскаа всевоинсьтва, прѣѡ́роуженоу же силоу · слово въплощеесѧ прѣкѣпющее · и грѣхы потрѣбиль е̃ · прѣславныи г̃ь ꙗко прослависѧ :~
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos: In the deep once Pharaoh's host was overwhelmed by the heavily armed power; but the Word made flesh destroyed sins by His almighty strength: the most glorious Lord, for He is glorified!*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: приложивъ ѡтнесли ꙗко мр̃твець · и ѿпаде властно ѡти дръжавою · и немощины ѡблечесѧ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The ruler of the world, O Good One, unto whom we were enrolled because we obeyed not Thy commandment, is condemned by Thy Cross: for drawing near unto Thee as unto one mortal, he fell from the dominion of his power, and was shown to be weak and stripped of his power, he was clothed in infirmity!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Иꙁбавитель родоу чл̃чю · и нетлѣнноу животоу началникь · въ оудирь пришелъ е̃си · въскр̃сенїемь си раꙁьдравь съ мр̃тныꙗ пелены · егоже славословимь са славно б̃ъ прослависѧ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Deliverer of the human race, and Author of incorruptible life, Thou didst come into the world: by Thy Resurrection having torn asunder the shroud of death, Him we glorify, for gloriously is He glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Прѣвышешни ꙗвит̃таа всеꙗ видимыꙗ и невидимыꙗ твары прѣнодбо, ꙁижителꙗ бо роди ꙗкоже иꙁволи · въплътнетсѧ въ оутробѣ твоеи · е̃гоже съ дръꙁновенїемь моли · сп̃сти д̃ши наша :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Shown to be higher than all creation, visible and invisible, O most pure one; for thou didst bear the Creator as He willed to become incarnate in thy womb: Whom entreat with boldness to save our souls!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: інь ка̃ кр̃тоу · твореніе кнры їѡа · дамаскына пѣ̃ а̃ · і рм̃ь · Градите людїе поемь пѣ̃ :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Cross, work of Sir John of Damascus. Ode 1. Heirmos: Come, ye people, let us sing a song...*[^53]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: На кр̃тѣ понесе волею х̃е б̃е · гꙋбителꙗ оубилъ е̃си и посрадилного раꙁлити на тоs лїа · и чл̃кы ѡбновивы · ꙗко прослави сѧ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Borne upon the Cross willingly, O Christ God, Thou didst slay the destroyer, and pour shame upon his wickedness, and having renewed mankind: for He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Повелѣваемь е̃смь мѵ́роносицамь радѡ́ · оу̃чнкѡ́м си глааше · пѣ̃ вѣкъ въꙁвѣстите мое еже иꙁ мр̃твы ѡ́браꙁы побѣныꙗ · ꙗко прослави :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Commanded with joy, the myrrh-bearing women said unto His disciples: Proclaim My victory over the dead unto ages: for He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Кто̃ иꙁрещи тебе достоино можеть, ꙁачатїе паче словеси · б̃а бо плътїю родила е̃си прѣч̃таа · на ꙗвльшасѧ сп̃санїа :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Who can worthily recount of thee the conception beyond word? For thou didst bear God in the flesh, O most pure one, Who appeared for our salvation!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Невещестъвныꙗ древле лѣствица · и страньно ѡла дѣкшїн поутъ морю · твое скаꙁаше рж̃тво ч̃истаꙗ · еже поемь владычнце, ꙗко прослави :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Heirmos the same:*[^54]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Сила вышнаго соущество съвръшеньно бж̃їа моудрости · въплъщьшеесѧ ѡтнетлаинетебе · къ чловѣкѡ́мь приближисѧ · ꙗко прослависѧ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The immaterial ladder of old, and the path strangely made dry through the sea, foreshadowed thy childbearing, O pure Lady, which we sing: for He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Сила вышнаго соущество съвръшеньно бж̃їа моудрости · въплъщьшеесѧ ѡтнетлаинетебе · къ чловѣкѡ́мь приближисѧ · ꙗко прослависѧ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* The Power of the Most High, the perfect hypostasis of the Wisdom of God, having become incarnate incorruptibly of thee, drew near unto mankind: for He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Проиде сквоꙁѣ дверь непроднжѫ · ꙁатворенныꙗ ѿтробы твоеꙗ · правдѣ слнце пр̃чтаа · мирови въссїавы ꙗко прослависѧ :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He passed through the impenetrable closed door of thy womb, the Sun of Righteousness, O most pure one, shining forth upon the world: for He is glorified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ г̃ і рм̃ · Процвѣла е̃сть поустынїа ꙗко кринь г̃и · ꙗꙁычнаꙗ неплодѧщи цр̃кви инѣ пришествїе̃ ти, ѡ неиже оутвръдисѧ мое ср̃дце :~
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: The wilderness hath blossomed as a lily, O Lord, the barren Church of the Gentiles by Thy coming, wherein my heart is established.*[^55]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Тварь къ стр̃ти твоеи иꙁмѣнꙗшесѧ · ꙁрѧщи тѧ въ нищетьнѣ ѡ́браꙁѣ · беꙁаконнины поръгаема · и́же ѡсновавшаго всѧ · бж̃твны мановенїемь :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Creation was altered at Thy Passion, beholding Thee in humble form mocked by the lawless, Who didst establish all things by Thy divine nod!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ̃ пръстн по ѡ́браꙁꙋ мѧ, рѫкою своею съꙁдавь · и съкроушена же пакы въ пръстѣ съ мр̃тьнѣи, грѣхомь х̃е, съшьдъ въ адъ совоꙁдвиже мѧ въскр̃сенїе̃мь :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having formed me of dust in Thine image with Thine own hand, and broken again into the dust of death by sin, O Christ, having descended into Hades, Thou hast raised me together by Thy Resurrection!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Чинно оудивиша сѧ аг̃г̃лстии пр̃чтаа и ч̃л̃чаа ѡустрашиша сѧ ср̃ца, ѡ́ рожествѣ твоемь · тѣм же бц̃ю тѧ вѣрнїи почитаемь :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The angelic ranks were filled with wonder, O most pure one, and human hearts were awed at thy childbearing; therefore we, the faithful, honor thee as Theotokos!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: інь кр̃тꙋ · і рм̃о · На каменни мѧ вѣры оутвръди :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Cross. Heirmos: Establish me upon the rock of faith...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Водоу длнїе поустивъ коупнѣ и кровь, ѡ́бе̃съ дертстна исто̃чника ребрь бж̃їихъ · напоинь въꙁвеселимѧ, и пою нѣста ꙗко же б̃ъ нашъ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Pouring forth water and blood together from the immortal fountain of the divine side, Thou hast given drink and made me glad, and I sing: There is none holy like our God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: В сего да въс̃движе па̃шаго · и въсꙁѧ мѧ на рамо ꙁаблужьшаго, въскресъ въꙁведн мѧ · и пою нѣста ꙗко же б̃ъ нашъ, инѣ праве :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having raised up the fallen [man], and taken me, the lost one, upon His shoulders, risen He brought me back; and I sing: There is none holy like our God, none righteous!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Т ы е̃дина паче въсеꙗ ꙁемлы · велїю спо̃би выше е̃ства · б̃а бо невмѣстимаго всеи твари, во оутробѣ своеи во̃мѣстила е̃си, тѣ же бц̃ю всн тѧ ꙁнае :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou alone beyond all the earth wast granted great things above nature; for the God Whom no creation can contain, thou hast contained in thy womb; therefore we all acknowledge thee as Theotokos!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: И же времень прѣвышешни всѧтскыхь · ꙗко временедѣлъ творець ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Pure Theotokos. Heirmos the same:*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: и́ с тебе д̃во волею младенець съꙁдасѧ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* He Who is above all times, as the Creator and Maker of time was willingly formed of thee as an infant, O Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Чрѣво пространѣиши н̃бсь въспоимь · егоже ради Адамь на н̃бсѣхь радꙋꙗсѧ живеть :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Let us hymn the womb more spacious than the heavens, for whose sake Adam lives rejoicing in the heavens!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: По рожествѣ непорочнаа · ꙗкоже преже рожества прѣбы · б̃а бо роди · дрѣвомь ч̃лка сп̃сьша · прѣчистаа вл̃д̃чце · и ꙁастоупнице родꙋ нашемꙋ :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* After childbearing, O undefiled one, thou didst remain even as before childbearing; for thou didst bear God Who saved man by the Tree, O most pure Lady and Protectress of our race!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ д̃ і рм̃ · Пришествовавь ѿ д̃вы , ни ходатаин ни аг̃г̃ль · нъ ты самь г̃и въплъщьсѧ · и сп̃се всего мѧ ч̃лка · тѣм же ꙁовоу ти слава силѣ твоеи г̃и :~
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Coming from the Virgin, neither an intercessor nor an angel, but Thou Thyself, O Lord, didst become incarnate and saved all of me, a man; therefore I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!*[^56]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Прѣстоꙗ ꙗко ѡ́сꙋжень б̃же мои , сꙋдищоу не въпїꙗ г̃и · сꙋдъ ис посл̃а ꙗꙁыкѡ́мь · и́же стр̃тїю твоею, вселенѣ не съдѣла х̃е сп̃сенїе :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Standing before the tribunal as one condemned, my God, without crying out, O Lord, Thou didst send forth judgment unto the nations, and by Thy Passion, O Christ, Thou hast wrought salvation for the world!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Стр̃тїю твоею врагоу ѡрꙋжїа ѡскоудѣша · противныꙗ же е̃же въ адъ съхоженїе̃ ти · гради раꙁдроушиша сѧ · и см̃рти держава раꙁорена бы :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By Thy Passion the weapons of the enemy failed, and by Thine adversary-crushing descent into Hades the strongholds were destroyed, and the dominion of death was overthrown!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ пристанище е̃псенїю · и стѣноу недвижимꙋ · б̃це вл̃д̃чце все вѣрны ты бѡ́ мл̃твами ѿ бѣ̃дь спасаеши д̃ша наша :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, the haven of salvation and unshakable wall, all we faithful [have acquired], O Lady Theotokos; for by thy prayers thou dost deliver our souls from afflictions!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: інь к р̃тоу · і рм̃ь · По̃ѧ тѧ слоухѡ́мь ·
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Cross. Heirmos: Hearing the report of Thee...*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Е̃дины ꙗко точило г̃и · попралъ е̃си врагы си · моужьное бѡ́ видѣти ѡдѣꙗнне по слꙗща съ крѣпостїю · врагъ въсегꙋбитель падесѧ, падыи же Адамъ въꙁдвижень бы :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Alone as in a winepress, O Lord, Thou didst tread down Thine enemies; for seeing Thy manly raiment dyed with strength, the all-destroying enemy fell, and fallen Adam was raised up!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Се прїнде прадѣд̃ла, иꙁводѧ ѡ́кованныꙗ · волщенїе оубо ꙗко во брыла ѡблечениѣ всего мѧ всегодна иꙁводи, ѿ всеволѣꙁненаидан плѣнника :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Behold, He came unto the forefather, leading forth the bound: having clothed Himself with our nature as a warrior with armor, He led me forth whole from the all-painful enemy, a captive!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: коу · и же хвалѧщаꙗ тѧ сп̃си · бл̃г̃венаа и пр̃ч̃таа по̃ д̃во :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou alone, O Theotokos, didst become higher than all creation; for thou didst bear the Creator and hold Him in thine arms save those who praise thee, O blessed and all-pure Virgin!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: інь ір̃м то б̃ци · Се прѣвъꙁнесесѧ бж̃твьнаꙗ гора · храмь гн̃ь прѣвыше силъ · б̃ца ꙗко е̃стъвнѣ :~
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Theotokos. Heirmos: Lo, the divine mountain is exalted, the house of the Lord above the hosts, the Theotokos manifestly.*

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Законъ е̃стъвеныꙗ покро̃вѣ · е̃дина рождеши владѧщиго тварїю · сподобнсѧ бж̃твьнаго ꙁванна :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Transcending the laws of nature, having alone borne the Ruler of creation, thou wast accounted worthy of the divine calling!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Чюдо како не ѡпали ѻ́гнь стыꙗ твоꙗ оутробы · ꙗкоже древле коупиноу проѡ́браꙁоующн чнстаа · чюдно е̃ не страшно е̃ ти рожество · и д̃ьже а̃пл̃ьскыи ликъ въꙁвеличисѧ :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Marvel! How the fire did not consume thy holy womb, prefiguring the bush of old, O pure one! Marvelous and awesome is thy childbearing, wherein the apostolic choir was magnified!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: пѣ̃ е̃ · ір̃мь · Ходатаи б̃оу · и ч̃лко̃мь бы х̃е б̃е · тобою вл̃ко · и́же къ пръвоначалномꙋ свѣтоу ѻ́ц̃оу твоемоу · ѿ нощи невидѣнїꙗ привндѣнїе ѡбрѣтохомь :~
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Thou wast a Mediator between God and men, O Christ God; through Thee, O Master, we have found access from the night of ignorance unto the primal light, Thy Father.*[^57]

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́ко кедръ х̃е врагѡ́ шатанїе съкроушилъ е̃си волею вл̃ко · на кѵпарисе бл̃гоиꙁволилъ е̃си · на певкѣ и кедрѣ плътыю своею въꙁдвиꙁаемь :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As a cedar, O Christ, Thou didst crush the pride of enemies, O Master, willingly consenting to be lifted up in Thy flesh upon the cypress, the pine, and the cedar!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Въ ровѣ х̃е прѣисподнѣмь · положиша тѧ беꙁ дыханіа мрътва · и́же своею раною ꙗꙁвковины моꙗ ꙗꙁвеныꙗ сп̃се · и́ же въ гробѣхъ съпащаꙗ, съ собою въскрѣсилъ е̃си :~
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* In the nether pit, O Christ, they laid Thee dead, without breath, Who by Thy wound healed my festering wounds, O Savior, and didst resurrect with Thyself those who slept in the tombs!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Моли своего сн̃а и г̃а · д̃во ч̃ти та а̃пл̃ѣ нны иꙁбавленіе · ѿ съпротивныхь настоꙗнїи · на тѧ оуповающимь смѣреніе даровати :~
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Entreat Thy Son and Lord, O pure Virgin, [granting] deliverance to the captive, and to bestow peace from adverse assaults upon those who hope in thee!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Ты во ѡ́мрацѣ бѣ̃вшꙋю драгмꙋ · въꙁискавь ѡбрѣ г̃и · на кр̃тѣ же тъ плотїю · косїажи во т̃ь по е̃хе лїніетвое · ты востанїꙗ хотѧ, пашаго вꙁываеши г̃и · дроугнсины своя гл̃ѧ рауите д̃и ·

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Seeking the drachma lost in darkness, Thou didst find it, O Lord: for upon the Cross in the flesh Thou didst shine forth Thy light; desiring the resurrection of the fallen, Thou callest Thine own friends, saying: Rejoice with Me! Therefore we praise Thy Resurrection, O Christ

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having given birth to Christ, the all-blessed Creator of all, rejoice, O pure one! Rejoice, thou who hast borne the Light for all! Rejoice, thou who didst contain the uncontainable God!

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Ye clouds, drop down the sweetness of gladness upon those on earth; for a Child is given, the Son Who is before ages, the Most High incarnate of the Virgin!

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Through our bodily life the Light shone forth, and dissolved the gloom of sin: at the last incarnate of the Virgin, O all-blessed one, the Most High!

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast adorned beyond all angelic majesty, having conceived God, the Creator of the angels, O most pure Mother, having taken flesh and being ensouled and incarnate, O undefiled one!

items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Held fast in the abyss of sins, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy compassion: from corruption, O my God, raise me up!*[^58]

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* As an evildoer the Righteous One was condemned, and with two lawless men is nailed to the Tree, granting remission unto the guilty by His own blood!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
items.slavonic_text: Ты во ѡ́мрацѣ бѣ̃вшꙋю драгмꙋ · въꙁискавь ѡбрѣ г̃и · на кр̃тѣ же тъ плотїю · косїажи во т̃ь по е̃хе лїніетвое · ты востанїꙗ хотѧ, пашаго вꙁываеши г̃и · дроугнсины своя гл̃ѧ рауите д̃и ·
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Unto the first-formed by one man, Adam, of old death entered into all the world; and by the one Son of God resurrection was bestowed!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Without knowing man thou didst bear God, and dost remain ever-virgin, revealed as the true dawn of the Godhead, shining forth the images of thy God!

items.office: On Sunday at Matins, at "God is the Lord", Troparion, Tone 2: When Thou didst descend unto death... (twice); and as at Vespers [the Theotokion] (once). Then after the first stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*[^49]
